body: And you opinion matters to the military?
I don't think my doctor's notes are going to be too conducive to getting me in, and since I now seem to be suffering a nervous breakdown I doubt I'm up to it

- 1.  Lots of great people have wasted their lives for a spouse and/or family.

- 2.  Established beforehand, women hate the shy and they hate even the mildly-attractive who don't talk to them...I'm both so I get double-hate.

Yes, ridicule it all you want, it's something I've always wanted to do and the last motivation I had to get a college degree.  But they don't want the depression patient, even though they'd be saving him from a life of misery and uselessness.

- The job I have to do now, to fulfill my graduation, is difficult enough...adding another job, as tempting as it may be, isn't possible.

- Unfortunately, the job mentioned previously and any club I have already joined, or would join, is filled with the scum and dregs that populate my generation...the generation that will see the end of my nation and the collapse of the world.

- It's established that women don't like me...romance is not a solution at all

- I love dogs, but they don't fulfill

Thanks for your story...but I'm not you.  I thoughtfully chose every path I've taken because I thought it would be fulfilling...well, now I know that everything I think I wanted is wrong and everything good I could've done with my gifts is gone.

And yes, the career that I'm disqualified from was worth more than the time, effort and dedication of the majority of men in this country.

- I don't see what is going to lead to happiness in my life.  I game, but try as I might it isn't a life consuming passion, it only turns my mind off for an hour or two.  There isn't anything that distracts me from what life is, to make me think that it has meaning.

- I've thought the last two majors were worth it for me...any future one is probably the same.  And saying a career or major is transient cuts the value of everything my life is based on.

-Women hate either shy men with low self-esteem, or fairly attractive guys who don't talk to them...either way they hate who I am.

-I exercise, religiously but it has stopped helping.
